1988, Road and Track, volume 39, Hearst Communications:
Mary Oliver: The words of the spirit wash over us to be a tranquil picture of things that repeat, of a puppy named Kuku, of sdrawkcab things like witch hazel, and holiday ear powder.
Imagine taking a break and coming back only to find your words and phrases are all !sdrawkcab (one step forward two steps back, no wonder why she took that axe!–[…])
